summary: Strapi is an open-source headless content management framework built with Node.js. It allows developers to define content structures and automatically generates a REST or GraphQL API to manage that data. This lets you build custom user interfaces or frontend applications while relying on a centralized backend for content storage.
goodFor: It suits developers who want to quickly set up a structured API-driven content backend using JavaScript and TypeScript without writing boilerplate code.
watchOut: Content management frameworks of this type often introduce significant database complexity and can be resource-heavy compared to flat-file or purely static alternatives.
deployNotes: As a Node.js application, it typically requires a persistent storage layer, a connection to a separate relational database, and a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
